body: # Economic Calendar. Our real-time Economic Calendar keeps track of all financial events and economic indicators that drive the markets. The Economic Calendar contains a full descriptions of the events and their relative importance in affecting the market, in addition to previous, forecast and actual figures as they're announced. ### What is the Investing.com Economic Calendar? The Economic Calendar is a real-time, streaming schedule of economic events and data releases that can move financial markets. You can filter the calendar by importance level to focus on the events that matter most to you. You can also toggle the display to show either the event time or the time remaining until each announcement. We are proud to share our economic calendar with you, but would remind you that due to external factors beyond our control, Investing.com cannot be held responsible for any trading losses or other losses incurred as a result of using the economic calendar.
